
{{alias}}( x, indices, value )
    Returns a new ndarray with the element at a specified index replaced by a
    provided value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input array.

    indices: Array<integer>
        Indices of the value to replace.

    value: any
        Replaced value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ] );
    > var out = {{alias}}( x, [ 0, 0 ], 5 )
    <ndarray>[ [ 5, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ]


{{alias}}.assign( x, indices, value, out )
    Copies elements from an input ndarray to an output ndarray and replaces the
    element at a specified index with a provided value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input array.

    indices: Array<integer>
        Indices of the value to replace.

    value: any
        Replaced value.

    out: ndarray
        Output array. Must have the same shape as the input array.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ] );
    > var y = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/empty-like}}( x );
    > var out = {{alias}}.assign( x, [ 0, 0 ], 5, y )
    <ndarray>[ [ 5, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ]
    > var bool = ( out === y )
    true

    See Also
    --------
